item.title: Shanghai Opens Extensive Drone Free-Fly Zones to Boost Low-Altitude Economy
item.description: Shanghai will permit consumer drones to fly in designated airspace without prior declaration under new regulations designed to support the country’s low-altitude economy. The municipal government’s new guidelines allow micro, light, and small registered unmanned aerial vehicles to operate freely in certain suitable airspace.

item.title: Shanda Group's MiroMind Shifts AI Research to Singapore
item.description: Shanda Group subsidiary MiroMind has asked some staff in Shanghai to relocate to Singapore, focusing its artificial general intelligence research exclusively in the city-state. This move follows a reorganisation announcement by Shanda and Singapore-based MiroMind. Credit: UNSPLASH The reorganisation states MiroMind will concentrate on artificial general intelligence, or AGI, and fundamental technology breakthroughs in Singapore. item.title: Baidu Launches Ernie 5.0, AI Assistant Reaches 200 Million Monthly Users
item.description: Baidu has unveiled Ernie 5.0, its most advanced artificial intelligence model, capable of processing text, images, audio, and video. The Beijing-based company’s AI-powered assistant now serves 200 million monthly active users, marking significant growth. Credit: BAIDU Ernie 5.0 is a multimodal model featuring 2.4 trillion parameters. It was first previewed in Nov. and has since climbed global rankings for text performance. item.title: Amazon Prepares for Further Corporate Job Reductions
item.description: Amazon is planning a second wave of job cuts, targeting a total reduction of approximately 30,000 corporate workers. This follows an earlier round where the organisation eliminated about 14,000 white-collar positions.

item.title: French President Pushes Accelerated Social Media Ban for Young Teens
item.description: President Emmanuel Macron announced plans to fast-track legislation banning social media for children under 15. The French government aims for this ban to enter into force in Sept. with the start of the new school year.

item.title: China's Loneliness Economy Expands Amid Rising Solo Households
item.description: Analysts state a new wave of products and services addresses the safety, social, and mental health needs of China’s rapidly growing solo-living population. The number of people living alone in the country is skyrocketing.

item.title: Xiaomi Redmi Note 15 Pro+ 5G Review: Built For Physical Longevity
item.description: The new Redmi Note 15 series arrives to entice value-conscious buyers in the mid-range market. The series leans heavily into its ‘Titan Tough’ philosophy, pairing a reinforced build with upgraded battery life.

item.title: EU Investigates X Over Grok AI Sexualised Images
item.description: The European Union has launched an investigation into X following public outcry regarding the spread of manipulated sexualised images by its artificial intelligence Grok chatbot. The European Commission, the 27-nation bloc's executive arm, will investigate whether X protected consumers by properly assessing and mitigating risks related to Grok's functionalities.

item.title: iPhone 18 Pro Leaks Reveal Under-Display Face ID, Brighter Screens
item.description: Future Pro iPhone models are expected to feature a significant screen redesign, with reports indicating a major visual overhaul for the display. This change could include the flood illuminator, a component essential for Face ID, being hidden beneath the screen. Such a development would account for a smaller or shrunken Dynamic Island.

item.title: Apple Unveils New AirTag With Enhanced Range, Louder Speaker
item.description: Apple has unveiled its next-generation AirTag, featuring the same Apple Ultra Wideband chip found in the recent iPhone 17 lineup, the lightweight iPhone Air, the Apple Watch Ultra 3, and the Apple Watch Series 11. This integration expands its findability range and enables compatibility with more Apple devices.
